**Native peoples in Goleornacha get mass evicted.**

Recently after an international monetary fund calculated the GDP of Goleornacha, a surge of construction companies and rich foreign investors came to Goleornacha. The reason, Goleornacha has very high standards of living and the tourist attractions. Foreigners from Elseyr and Amaralo have steadily grown in Goleornacha over the past few years, but recently the Elseyrian population, especially of UREV republicans has taken a sharp increase. The result, non-natives became more powerful in Goleornacha, so powerful that they can control the public. Some examples are the Bavan'i people in Straitlan and Bavana bay have been hit with evictions so the foreigners can build highrise buildings. In tui bay and south-east straitlan, the tu'i and lu peoples have been hit hard, with the majority of homeless civilians being of tu'i and lu descent. The goleoran goverment is still trying to fix the housing problem.
